supplementalInitialFixes.name: download: a file replaces a file atomically (exec bit kept); a directory lands at local_path; an existing directory is refused
supplementalInitialFixes.reason: Investigated retained incoming-baseline failure (30.26 ms, BOX_TRANSFER_FAILED: Premature close). Native host extraction stopped at archive end markers before the entire remote stream reached EOF. The production owner now uses --ignore-zeros to read all bytes through the existing bounded pipeline. Existing real directory case appends valid zero padding larger than a pipe buffer, making early native extraction observable without sleeps or another workflow.
supplementalInitialFixes.independentContract: Boxes spec §13 box_download: stream files/directories out of a box to the calling chat project. Complete valid archives must succeed; incomplete/failed transfers leave no partially published output. GNU tar and libarchive documentation independently specify the default zero-block stopping behavior and --ignore-zeros read-through behavior.
supplementalInitialFixes.credibleFailure: A valid archive with delayed or backpressured zero padding causes native tar to exit before Node ends stdin, failing an otherwise successful user download with ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE/EPIPE.
supplementalInitialFixes.independentOracle: Actual downloaded BINARY file bytes and executable mode, build.log/nested file content, ALREADY_EXISTS/NOT_FOUND outcomes and no staging files. The source adds only legal all-zero archive padding; expected artifacts remain literal and do not depend on production flags.

supplementalInitialFixes.refactorResistance: No assertion inspects tar argv or pipeline call shape; any implementation that correctly downloads complete padded archives and maintains atomicity passes.
